name: Do I need an architect, or can a design-build company handle my bedroom addition?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an architect, or can a design-build company handle my bedroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text:
An architect or designer may be useful for complex architectural, historic, or highly customized work, but the more important question is who will coordinate design, engineering, permits, and construction. Elite Remodeling & Design operates as a residential design-build company, so its stated process combines design development with construction coordination.

A separate designer and builder can work well when responsibilities are clearly divided, but handoffs may create gaps in scope, pricing, or constructability. A design-build arrangement can simplify communication while still requiring a detailed agreement.

Key factors:
- Project complexity and structural changes
- Who prepares drawings and engineering
- Who submits and responds to permit comments
- How changes affect the construction price

Before signing, ask for the design deliverables, exclusions, allowances, payment stages, and change-order process. Choose the structure that gives you clear accountability for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A design-build company may coordinate design, construction plans, permitting, and construction for a bedroom addition, while complex or specialized projects may need additional professionals. Confirm who provides drawings, engineering, permit responses, selections, pricing, and construction oversight.
